Luxury Dentistry, Exceptional Smiles

QUALITY, CONVENIENCE, & COMPASSION

At Midtown Dental Group, we’ve crafted a new kind of dentistry that puts you at the forefront of all we do. With locations across Manhattan, Brooklyn, and New Jersey, we ensure your experience is seamless, patient-centric, and uncompromising in quality every step of the way. Our team is dedicated to crafting smiles that not only look great but also reflect our commitment to what matters most – you. We invite you to discover the difference and start your journey toward a healthier, more confident smile.

Midtown Dental Group: Your Partners in Exceptional Care

Founded by Dr. Daniell Mishaan in 2008, Midtown Dental Group has multiple convenient locations across New York and New Jersey, each managed by a team of experts who value your dental health as much as you do. Backed by state-of-the-art technology and clean, modern offices, you can expect nothing but the best when in our care.

We offer a diverse suite of services designed to address every aspect of your dental needs. From foundational general dentistry ensuring the health of your teeth and gums to transformative cosmetic dentistry enhancing the aesthetics of your smile, we’ve got you covered.

OUR PARTNERS IN SUCCESS

DENTAL EXCELLENCE STARTS HERE

Midtown Dental Group’s Most Frequently Asked Questions

Need quick answers to common inquiries? At Midtown Dental Group, we understand the importance of transparency and want to ensure you have all the information you need for a confident and informed dental experience. Explore our FAQs to learn more.

How often should I schedule a dental check-up?

We highly recommend scheduling a dental check-up every six months. Regular visits help us monitor your oral health, address any issues early on, and provide preventive care for a lasting, healthy smile.

What types of insurance do you accept?

We prioritize providing exceptional care to all our patients, including those with dental insurance. For patients opting to use insurance, our team will assist you through the whole process. We are committed to transparency, ensuring you will always be informed about any costs associated with your treatment. Feel free to contact us to discuss your insurance coverage, and we’ll work together to ensure a seamless and transparent experience for you.

What should I expect during my first visit to Midtown Dental?

Your first visit will include a comprehensive examination, a discussion of your dental history and concerns, and possibly X-rays. Our team will work with you to create a personalized treatment plan and answer any questions you may have.

What safety measures do you have in place at your dental offices?

Your health and safety are our top priorities. Midtown Dental Group strictly adheres to industry-leading infection control protocols. We have implemented enhanced cleaning procedures, use personal protective equipment (PPE), and follow all recommended guidelines to ensure a safe environment for both patients and staff. If you have specific concerns, feel free to contact us for more information.
